## Verdict
REVISE — The three replacements are supported, but the activation transaction needs an explicit lock scope.

## Critical gaps
The lock must cover the fresh-source comparison, backup, activation, postchecks, and any rollback—not just replacement. Otherwise a concurrent writer could invalidate the comparison or be overwritten by rollback.

## Important improvements
None.

## Validation gaps
Compare installed bytes with the validated candidate before releasing the lock; if rollback occurs, verify restoration against the original backup.

## Recommended revision
Stage and validate → acquire lock → compare live source → back up → atomically replace → verify installed bytes and planned invariants → sync; on failure restore, verify, and sync before unlocking.

## Acceptance Contract
Acceptance level: attested
